meta_description:
3,246 likes, 87 comments - financebyanmoll on October 10, 2026: "“This market will never recover!”❌

“FIIs are continuously selling. Who’s going to buy Indian equities?”🇮🇳

“The Indian rupee is heading towards ₹100 against the dollar!”💰

“The Indian economy is collapsing. There’s no hope left!”😭

And a few years later?👀🕐

“I wish I had bought more!”✅

“Why did I panic and sell?”😅

“I missed such a golden opportunity!”🤝

Funny how every market crash looks like a disaster in the present and an opportunity in hindsight.🧠

2000, 2008, 2020. Different crises, different narratives, SAME human psychology.

Markets have never moved in straight lines. Bull runs, corrections, consolidations, recoveries. It’s a cycle, not the end of the world.

The real wealth creators understand this.

Everyone wants to buy at the bottom. Nobody wants to live through the fear that creates it.

And a few years from now, people might look back at this very phase and say the exact same thing:

“I wish I had bought more.”

Don’t borrow the crowd’s fear. Opportunities rarely feel like opportunities when you’re living through them.

#financebyanmoll".
